title: Zesty Fluffy Ukrainian Noodle Dish
description: A kid-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring nutty and fluffy noodles, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is also shojin-friendly and uses sous-vide cooking.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 00-flour, eggs, salt, and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a long rope.
Cut the rope into 1-inch pieces to form noodles.
Cook the noodles in a sous-vide water bath at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
In a small saucepan, melt the sous-vide butter over low heat.
Add dried parsley, lemon zest, and black pepper to the melted butter and stir to combine.
Toss the cooked noodles in the butter sauce until they are well coated.
Serve the noodles hot and enjoy.
